metadata.description: Deskmate's Claude Code plugins: the shared desk, and optional working habits.

plugins.name: deskmate
plugins.description: Use the shared Deskmate desk for browser and screen work. Its hooks link each session to the desk's activity feed and tell the secretary when a turn or session ends.

plugins.name: habits
plugins.description: Working habits: changelog entries, design docs and a wrap-up, with an end-of-turn changelog check.
